decisions.reason: A cutting and creasing finisher fits the firm's core postpress portfolio and has its own product page, so the firm is likely to keep selling it.
The UV spot varnishing system is further from the core offer, but its recent German premiere and home-page placement show the firm is still committed to the enhancement segment.
The sheet preparation module builds on the established modular systems and supports the automation strategy, so it complements other machines.
The B2 multifinisher was promoted as a flagship launch on the home page and matches the firm's direction toward digital finishing.
A hybrid saddle stitcher is central to booklet making, a core customer need, and has its own product page.
The folding add-on unit has a documented customer installation enabling one-pass finishing, which shows real market uptake.
